content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe-dependent setups bundle payment processing, hosting, and delivery into a single platform. Convenience is the lure, but it’s conditional. Access requires a supported bank account, tax ID, and stable currency. For creators in Nigeria, these prerequisites are non-starters. Stripe’s dashboard simplifies transactions but grants zero sovereignty. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack decouples infrastructure layers. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. Each component is free or low-cost. The stack automates product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You own the code, data, and deployment. No platform can revoke access. The tradeoff is clarity: you’re building infrastructure, not renting it. Stripe wins for simplicity in supported countries. The Edge Stack wins for sovereignty everywhere else.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe excludes Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and other high-risk regions due to compliance costs and currency volatility. Their risk model assumes instability. Workarounds like VPN-based accounts violate terms of service and trigger instant bans. PayPal similarly restricts accounts in these regions. Both platforms prioritize their banking relationships over merchant access. The Edge Commerce Stack bypasses this entirely. It uses NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which requires no KYC, no buyer account, and no centralized approval. Payments settle directly to your wallet. The stack deploys on globally accessible infrastructure: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase. No single entity can block access. This isn’t a hack—it’s base-layer architecture. Stripe’s exclusion is policy-driven. The Edge Stack’s inclusion is structurally guaranteed.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe processes payments in 2-7 days, minus 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Add currency conversion fees if your bank isn’t USD-compatible. In Nigeria, this often means double-dipping fees. Crypto payments via NOWPayments settle in minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction costs under $0.10. The Edge Stack’s upfront cost is $197, but you own the infrastructure permanently. No subscriptions. No per-transaction fees beyond NOWPayments’ cut. Stripe’s costs scale with volume. The Edge Stack’s costs are fixed. For high-volume creators, Stripe may save money—if it’s available. For creators in restricted regions, the Edge Stack is the only scalable option. Speed, fees, and ownership tilt decisively in its favor.
Stripe excludes Nigeria. The Edge Stack includes it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe’s automation is powerful but conditional. Product delivery, subscription management, and customer data all live on their platform. If your account is flagged or closed, you lose access. The Edge Commerce Stack inverts this. You own the GitHub repository, Supabase database, and Cloudflare deployment. Automation is handled via Cloudflare Workers—code you control. Product delivery is instant via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Customer data is stored in your Supabase instance. COREMERCH deploys the stack for you but retains zero access post-delivery. This is infrastructure sovereignty. Stripe automates more out-of-the-box but retains ultimate control. The Edge Stack requires more setup but grants ultimate ownership. Choose renting convenience or owning permanence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-supported country with a stable bank account, Stripe is the faster option. Its dashboard simplifies operations for low-volume sellers. If you’re in Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or another restricted region, Stripe is not an option. The Edge Commerce Stack is your only structural alternative. It’s built for creators who value ownership over convenience. The $197 investment buys lifetime infrastructure, not monthly subscriptions. Deployment takes 48 hours, not years. If you sell digital products globally and need to own your stack, this is your architecture. Stripe is a tool. The Edge Stack is a foundation. Choose based on your actual constraints, not hypothetical scenarios.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the only viable option for selling software in Stripe-restricted countries like Nigeria. It replaces Stripe’s payment processing with NOWPayments’ crypto verification, hosts your store on Cloudflare Pages, and automates delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You own the entire stack after deployment. No platform can revoke access. Stripe’s convenience is unavailable in these regions, making sovereign infrastructure the only structural solution.
Own your infrastructure. Rent nothing.

The stack includes Cloudflare Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers backend, Supabase order storage, and NOWPayments integration. It’s built for creators who need to own their infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform dependence. Just sovereign commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Provide your product files and payment wallet address to COREMERCH. 3. Receive deployed stack within 48 hours, including GitHub repository access. 4. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and confirm product delivery. 5. Update your marketing channels with the new store URL. 6. Monitor transactions via Supabase dashboard and NOWPayments webhook logs. 7. Scale by adding products directly to your Supabase instance—no platform approval required.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I already have a website?
Yes. The stack deploys as a standalone store or integrates with existing sites via Cloudflare Workers. Your main site can link to the store URL.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON networks for low fees.
Do I need technical skills to manage the stack?
Basic familiarity with GitHub and Cloudflare helps, but COREMERCH handles deployment. Post-delivery, the stack is designed for non-technical creators.
Can customers pay with fiat currency?
No. The stack uses crypto payments exclusively. Customers must send payment from their wallet. This avoids fiat restrictions in your region.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, payments pause until service resumes. Your store remains live. No data is lost.
Crypto payments settle in minutes, not days.
